buyers_guide.q: Do I need a range extender?
buyers_guide.a: If devices far from your hub drop off or respond slowly, yes. Every plug-in Z-Wave or Zigbee device already repeats, but a dedicated extender is cheap and can sit exactly where the mesh is weak.
Halfway between the hub and the devices that drop out, on an outlet that's always powered.

buyers_guide.q: Does it work with any hub?
buyers_guide.a: Z-Wave extenders work with any Z-Wave controller in your region. Zigbee repeaters work with most Zigbee hubs, but some only repeat for their own brand's devices.
